newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Allianz interested in Hungary bank sales.
newsitem.headline: Allianz interested in Hungary bank sales.

text.p: Germany's Allianz AG, Europe's largest insurer, is interested in buying a Hungarian bank which has wide national network, Mihaly Patai, Chairman and Managing Director of Hungaria Biztosito Rt said on Tuesday.
Hungaria Biztosito is Allianz's Hungarian insurance unit.

Patai was quoted by the Hungarian daily Napi Gazdasag as saying that the Allianz group may buy a stake in Takarekbank, the bank of Hungary's savings cooperatives, or in Kereskedelmi es Hitelbank (K&H), which is one of the country's top five banks.
Both Takarekbank and K&H are state-owned and are expected to be privatised this year or early next year.
Patai added that Hungaria Biztosito is also negotiating with two German financial institutions, including Bausparkasse Schwabische Hall, about founding a building society in Hungary.
Hungary's parliament is expected to approve the new law, which would allow the establishment of building societies, this year.
